capabilities: edit the Exif:ImageDescription tag in JPEG files
edit the XMP:dc:description tag in PNG and WEBP files
annotate photos from the image viewer screen
disambiguation: Edits metadata embedded inside image files (Exif/XMP), not Obsidian note properties or frontmatter.
extras: README is minimal: it lists supported tag/format pairs and directs feedback and bug reports to GitHub issues.
problem: Obsidian's image viewer displays images but offers no way to edit metadata embedded in image files such as Exif descriptions.
summary: Image metadata editor that lets users annotate photos with Exif and XMP descriptions directly from Obsidian's image viewer.
